Undercarriage check

Car undercarriage check in Bukit Indah

Strange noises or leaks from underneath? We check the underside of your car, show you what is worn and explain what matters.

WhatsApp usCall

What this service covers

The underside of your car takes a beating. It carries the suspension, steering parts, exhaust, drive shafts, fuel and brake lines and protective covers. Potholes, speed humps, wet roads and long drives all wear these parts. Many faults cannot be seen from above, so problems stay hidden until they get expensive. An undercarriage check puts the car up so we can look at each part properly and explain what we see. Visit us at Taman Bukit Indah, near the Second Link. We serve drivers across Iskandar Puteri and JB.

Signs you need this

  • Clunking or rattling noise over bumps and speed humps
  • Exhaust sounds louder or rattles underneath
  • Oil, fluid or water drips under the car after parking
  • Steering feels loose or the car wanders on the road
  • Car sits lower on one side or looks uneven
  • You hit a pothole or kerb hard recently

What we do

  1. 01

    Inspect underneath

    We raise the car and look over the suspension, steering parts, exhaust, drive shafts, lines and covers.

  2. 02

    Explain what we found

    We show you what is worn, loose or leaking and explain what is urgent and what can wait.

  3. 03

    Quote before work

    You get a quote for any repair. We do not start until you agree to it.

  4. 04

    Repair

    We replace or fix the worn parts, tighten what is loose and secure any covers.

  5. 05

    Re-check and test drive

    We look at the repaired area again, then drive the car to check noise and handling.

  6. 06

    Handover

    We explain what was done and what to keep an eye on.

What's included and what we check

  • Shock absorbers and springs
  • Bushes and control arms
  • Ball joints and tie rod ends
  • Drive shaft boots and joints
  • Exhaust pipes and mounts
  • Oil, fluid and coolant leaks
  • Brake and fuel lines
  • Under covers and fasteners

Questions drivers ask

What is an undercarriage check?

It is a visual and hands-on inspection of the parts under your car, such as suspension, steering, exhaust and lines. We look for wear, damage, looseness and leaks, then explain what we find. Many problems start small and are easy to fix early.

Why does my car clunk over bumps?

Worn bushes, loose links, weak shock absorbers or damaged mounts can all cause it. We need to see it on the lift to know which. We inspect, explain and quote before any repair. Do not ignore a new noise.

How often should I check the undercarriage?

A good time is at each service, and after a hard pothole or kerb hit. Driving in Johor rain and over rough roads can wear parts faster. We tell you what looks fine. Heavy loads and flooded roads also add wear.

Can I tell if there is a leak under my car?

Look for stains on the ground where you park. Dark oil, coloured coolant or clear water can mean different things. Aircond water is normal. Tell us what you see and we will trace it. Do not ignore a puddle that keeps coming back.

Will the check find problems I cannot see?

That is the purpose. Many worn parts only show up from underneath. We tell you what we see, rank it by urgency and leave the decision to you. We will not push work you do not need.

How much does an undercarriage check cost?

Please WhatsApp 011-6776 1138 to ask about the check. Any repair that follows depends on the parts and the car, and we quote that before we start. You decide what to go ahead with.
